Scheme.Description: Samples realized and unrealized strategy P&L once per finished BTCUSDT five-minute candle, calculates equity and a persistent all-run peak confirmed by Highest, logs only rising crossings of a drawdown threshold, and opens one protected long market position per 1440-candle cooldown.
